description: The Payment Gateway via Valitor for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.9.41 does not properly validate the authenticity of payment callbacks, relying on a verification secret that ships with a hard-coded default value used by every store that has not changed it, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge a valid payment confirmation and mark arbitrary orders as paid.

title: CVE-2026-129466 - Zr.Admin.NET commit 1845017 through commit eb9228a contains a missing authorization vulnerability in
description: Zr.Admin.NET commit 1845017 through commit eb9228a contains a missing authorization vulnerability in TasksController.Get that allows any logged-in user to read scheduled task details without the monitor:job permission. Attackers can obtain task ids from the unprotected /monitor/jobLog/list endpoint and retrieve job parameters, API URLs, cron expressions, and stored SQL statements.

ai_analysis.impact_assessment: Potential security vulnerability with medium severity. CVE: CVE-2026-129466.

title: CVE-2026-129465 - Zr.Admin.NET commit af07ffc through commit eb9228a contains an insecure direct object reference vuln
description: Zr.Admin.NET commit af07ffc through commit eb9228a contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in SysProfileController.UpdateProfile that allows any authenticated user to modify other accounts via UserId. Attackers can set the administrator's phone number to one they control, request an SMS code via /checkMobile, and log in through /PhoneLogin to take over the administrator account.

ai_analysis.impact_assessment: Potential security vulnerability with high severity. CVE: CVE-2026-129465.

ai_analysis.impact_assessment: Potential security vulnerability with high severity. CVE: CVE-2026-129464.
